meta.title: Sebastian Hernandez — Software Engineer
meta.description: Software engineer building performant, accessible web and mobile apps in React, TypeScript, React Native, and Flutter — and a self-hosted AI and infrastructure platform (LLM gateway, GPU inference, IaC).

profile.title: Profile
profile.text: Software engineer with 3+ years building high-performance, accessible web and mobile apps in TypeScript, React, React Native, and Flutter. At Visa, shipped real-time dashboards and authentication flows serving millions of users; currently builds and operates a self-hosted AI and infrastructure platform (LLM gateway, GPU inference, IaC).

entries.title: Founding Software Engineer
bullets: Built React Native apps (authentication, profiles, search) in TypeScript with Expo Router and NativeWind.
Developed a React + Vite admin panel; enforced code quality with ESLint, Prettier, and Zod.
Patched the backend API to unblock frontend delivery.

entries.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed a React dashboard for real-time payment approval-rate monitoring across 15+ issuer clients, with configurable threshold alerts via email and in-app notifications.
Built a Flutter mobile demo app showcasing a peer-to-peer payments SDK for key stakeholder meetings in Chile, supporting regional business development.

Implemented WCAG accessibility support in the Visa Go Flutter app for the 2024 Paris Olympics, remediating gaps across a 30K+ user global audience and presenting findings to an internal accessibility expert.
Contributed to Visa Consumer Authentication Service (VCAS) in Java and Spring Boot, strengthening 3DS authentication for 10M+ cardholders; adapted platform APIs to Latin America partner requirements.
Earned 10+ Achievers Awards and reduced technical debt on legacy codebases 10+ years old.

entries.title: Self-Hosted AI Platform
entries.summary: A multi-provider LLM gateway, self-hosted GPU inference, and an on-demand ASR worker — engineered around one 8 GB GPU.
bullets: Multi-provider LLM gateway (LiteLLM) with automatic failover; Python automation live-probes a synced model catalog to filter dead or gated models, verified by a mock-provider harness.
Self-hosted GPU inference (Ollama, Open WebUI, search-grounded RAG) tuned to keep 9B-class models fully GPU-resident on an 8GB card via KV-cache quantization and measured context sizing.
On-demand ASR gateway (Python, Docker SDK): wakes a GPU transcription worker on request (~3s) and reclaims ~1.4GB RAM when idle; ~28x realtime.

entries.title: Homelab Infrastructure as Code
entries.summary: 25+ services kept running as code: Docker Compose stacks, monitoring, backups, and Zero Trust remote access provisioned with Terraform.
bullets: 25+ containerized services across Docker Compose stacks (DNS ad-blocking, monitoring, backups, label-scoped auto-healing); Zero Trust remote access as code via Terraform (Cloudflare provider v5).

entries.title: Resume as Code
entries.summary: This site: one JSON content source renders both the Typst CV PDFs and the React page, shipped by a post-commit deploy pipeline.
bullets: One JSON source of truth feeds the Typst-built CV PDFs and this web page, so the site and the downloads can never drift apart.
A git post-commit hook compiles the PDFs, content-hashes them, builds the site, and swaps it live — zero manual steps.
